# RahulChaube Runtime — Machine Readable AI Context & Technical Specification

> RahulChaube Runtime is a high-performance JavaScript & TypeScript runtime, package manager, test runner, and bundler developer platform.

## System Overview

- **Name**: RahulChaube Runtime
- **Version**: 1.0.0
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.rahulchaube.space
- **Target OS**: Linux (x86_64, aarch64), macOS (x86_64, arm64), Windows (x64)
- **Primary Engine**: High-performance V8/JavaScriptCore native runtime core
- **CLI Binary**: `rahulchaube` (21 built-in commands)

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Runtime Execution (`rahulchaube run`)
- Native execution of `.js`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, and `.jsx` files without external transpilers (Babel/tsc).
- Fast cold startup time (<20ms execution goal).
- Web-standard API implementation (`fetch`, `Request`, `Response`, `Headers`, `WebSocket`, `Crypto`, `Blob`, `URLPattern`).
- Full Node.js API compatibility layer (`fs`, `path`, `http`, `crypto`, `os`, `stream`, `events`, `buffer`, `util`, `child_process`).

### 2. Package Management (`rahulchaube install`, `add`, `remove`, `update`, `why`, `graph`)
- High-speed package resolution and installation.
- Text-based lockfile resolution (`rahulchaube.lock` format compatibility).
- Global content-addressable package caching.
- Package dependency graph visualization (`rahulchaube graph`).
- Dependency explanation engine (`rahulchaube why <package>`).
- Security vulnerability audit scanner (`rahulchaube audit`).
- Open-source dependency license auditor (`rahulchaube licenses`).

### 3. Bundling & Compiling (`rahulchaube build`)
- Production bundling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and JSX.
- Code-splitting, tree-shaking, and minification.
- Target formats: `browser`, `node`, `rahulchaube`.

### 4. Developer Experience & Diagnostics (`rahulchaube doctor`, `explain`, `optimize`)
- Built-in environment diagnostic suite (`rahulchaube doctor`).
- AI-assisted error resolution assistant (`rahulchaube explain "<error>"`).
- Source-code performance optimization scanner (`rahulchaube optimize`).
- Project scaffolding wizard (`rahulchaube create <template> <name>`).
- Migration tool for npm, yarn, pnpm (`rahulchaube migrate <pm>`).

### 5. Plugin Ecosystem (`rahulchaube plugins`)
- Plugin management system using `rahulchaube-plugin-*` prefix.
- Commands: `rahulchaube plugins list`, `install`, `update`, `remove`.

## Command Line Interface (21 Built-in Commands)

1. `rahulchaube run <script|file>` — Execute script or TS/JS file
2. `rahulchaube test [file]` — Run unit test suite
3. `rahulchaube build [entry]` — Bundle source code for production
4. `rahulchaube install` — Install dependencies from package.json
5. `rahulchaube add <pkg>` — Add dependency to package.json
6. `rahulchaube remove <pkg>` — Remove dependency from package.json
7. `rahulchaube update [pkg]` — Update installed dependencies
8. `rahulchaube audit` — Scan dependencies for security vulnerabilities
9. `rahulchaube licenses` — Audit third-party package licenses
10. `rahulchaube why <pkg>` — Explain dependency resolution path
11. `rahulchaube graph` — Display ASCII dependency tree
12. `rahulchaube create <template> [name]` — Scaffold project template
13. `rahulchaube doctor` — Run environment health checks
14. `rahulchaube explain <error>` — AI error diagnostic assistant
15. `rahulchaube optimize` — Scan project for performance tips
16. `rahulchaube migrate <pm>` — Convert project from npm/yarn/pnpm
17. `rahulchaube cache clean` — Clear package binary caches
18. `rahulchaube plugins list` — List installed CLI plugins
19. `rahulchaube plugins install <plugin>` — Install CLI plugin
20. `rahulchaube plugins update` — Update all CLI plugins
21. `rahulchaube plugins remove <plugin>` — Uninstall CLI plugin

## Feature Implementation Status Matrix

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| TypeScript & JSX Runtime | Implemented | Direct execution with zero tsc setup |
| Fast Cold Startup | Implemented | Cold boot under 20ms |
| Node.js API Layer | Implemented | Supports major npm packages |
| Lockfile Package Manager | Implemented | Fast dependency resolution |
| Dependency Graph Viewer | Implemented | ASCII tree via `rahulchaube graph` |
| AI Error Diagnostic | Implemented | Via `rahulchaube explain` |
| Production Bundler | Implemented | Minification & tree-shaking |
| Plugin System | Implemented | `rahulchaube-plugin-*` extension model |
| System Doctor Diagnostics | Implemented | Via `rahulchaube doctor` |
| Web Standards APIs | Implemented | Fetch, Request, Response, Crypto, WebSocket |
| Standalone Compiler Binaries | Experimental | Single-file executable compilation |
| Distributed Cache Proxy | Planned | Roadmap feature for enterprise teams |
